en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet village street with dirt road curving between houses with steep tiled roofs. A church tower with a clock face and tall spire dominates the left background. Trees and fenced gardens line the slope on the left, and a stone column or wayside cross stands near the center-right of the road. A single child in a dark dress walks in the middle of the street; a cart is parked near the buildings on the far right. No visible caption or printed text is present on the image side.
